project_title: Atelier Ink & Steel — Luxury Scandinavian Pen Store
design_archetype: Warm Editorial Luxury meets Scandinavian Minimalism

theme.mode: Light Editorial Warmth with Dark Mode Toggle Support

headings.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
headings.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug

layout_and_spacing.hero_section: Asymmetrical Swiss layout with left editorial typography block (span 7) and right off-grid multi-depth image cluster (span 5). Max heading text-6xl.
layout_and_spacing.catalog_grid: 3-column responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8) with elevated filter drawer / sticky filter bar
layout_and_spacing.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid (MODE B) with tight gaps (gap-4 to gap-6), strict table structures, status badges, and quick modal edit triggers
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard with generous padding (p-6 to p-12 for containers, py-16 to py-24 for page sections)
layout_and_spacing.container_borders: All bordered containers MUST include internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision with crisp 1px borders (#E6E0D6)

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper noise background overlay with opacity 0.03 for organic warmth
visual_enhancers.surface_style: Tactile Scandinavian cardless and subtle card styles with border-[#E6E0D6] and soft drop shadow shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(28,24,21,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Header navigation bar using bg-[#FAF8F5]/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E6E0D6] z-50
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Gradient text overlays on photography using max opacity bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1C1815]/60 via-[#1C1815]/20 to-transparent (never flat heavy overlays)

navigation_and_header.header: Fixed top bar with brand mark 'ATELIER INK & STEEL', key links (Fountain Pens, Rollerball, Ballpoint, Inks, Limited Editions, About, Admin), search modal trigger, user account button, cart drawer button with item badge.
navigation_and_header.mobile_nav: Slide-out editorial menu panel with oversized category links and smooth motion transitions

key_features_to_implement.home_page: Hero statement, Craftsmanship Spotlight, Curated Categories (7 types), Featured Products with hover preview, Brand Story editorial block, Customer reviews / testimonials slider.
key_features_to_implement.product_catalog: Full search bar, multi-category filters, brand filter, price range slider, sort dropdown (Price low-high, high-low, newest), view toggles (Grid/List).
key_features_to_implement.product_detail: Multi-image thumbnail gallery, interactive nib size selection (Fine, Medium, Broad, Italic), ink color pairing recommendation, technical specs accordion, custom engraving text box, add to cart with animation.
key_features_to_implement.cart_and_checkout: Slide-over cart drawer with mini item preview, shipping calculator, promo code field, and multi-step guest/user checkout supporting Stripe payment element mock.
key_features_to_implement.user_account: Order history timeline, tracking number link, saved shipping address manager, wishlist collection.
key_features_to_implement.admin_panel: Data-dense control center for uploading product details and photos, updating stock levels, managing order statuses (Processing, Shipped, Delivered), and updating shipment tracking numbers.

testing_instructions.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs, filter checkboxes, order actions, admin upload buttons, shipment tracking status buttons) MUST have a unique data-testid in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as heavy gradients or Inter font for main headings.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky elements or dropdown menus.
Ensure all buttons have explicit hover and active states (e.g. hover:bg-[#2B3327] hover:text-[#FAF8F5]).
Keep max hero heading size to text-6xl (avoid text-8xl slop).
Always use kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements.
